chosen.title: city street traffic by night
chosen.why: Night city street at street level: a wall of lit signs rendered as soft bokeh across the top of frame (no readable text), parked scooters silhouetted in the foreground, a car pulling away with red tail lights centre-frame at 2.3s. Reads instantly as 'evening street, signs lit, people heading home'. Natural documentary feel, not staged. Downsides: only 720p available on Mixkit, no pedestrians in frame, and the neon bokeh is fairly saturated (will need the planned desaturation grade). Avoid 20s onward: the clip racks out of focus and goes dark.

alternates.why: 1080p Tokyo street corner with many lit shop signs and pedestrians crossing; at 3.0s a man in a red shirt and others cross under the signs. Caveats: Japanese sign text is clearly readable (violates the no-text rule and looks foreign for a Korean promo), footage is sped-up with a blurred passer-by crossing the foreground at 1.5-2.0s, and the colour is very warm/yellow and saturated.

1080p tree-lined pedestrian street at night with lamp light and people walking toward camera (sharpest group around 3.5s). Caveats: it is a long-exposure timelapse so people ghost and jump between frames, and there are no lit shop signs, so the 'sign' half of the brief is missing.

notes: Sheets used: 'city night street' (20), 'evening street lights' (3), 'people walking city night' (13), 'commuters evening' (0), 'neon signs street' (6), 'shopping street night' (6). Rejected on sight: 41160 (English marquee text), 2011 (Chinese gate text), 3558 (staged two women laughing to camera under pink neon, faces large), 20089/20087 (wide aerial timelapse of Seoul), 8845/100862 (staged couple/friends), aerial and driving-timelapse clips. 4th download 3558 was reviewed and dropped. Chosen 6754 is the only candidate where lit signage and a street-level evening street read instantly with no text/logos, but it is 720p and has no pedestrians, hence fit 6. If the editor wants 1080p with people, 4451 is the fallback provided Japanese signage is acceptable.
